appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Declining Emergency Department Visits in Region Z from 2012 to 2023'.
Chart subtitle: 'Regional monitoring record shown in the dashboard summary'.
Single red line series plotted from 2012 to 2023.

The line begins near 1200 visits in 2012, rises to a plateau around 2400 visits from 2018 to 2020, then sharply increases to a peak near 3400 visits in 2022, followed by a decline to approximately 3000 visits in 2023.

printed_facts.fact: Title explicitly states 'Declining Emergency Department Visits in Region Z from 2012 to 2023'.
Subtitle states 'Regional monitoring record shown in the dashboard summary'.
Y-axis has major gridlines and labels at 0, 800, 1600, 2400, and 3200.
X-axis has labeled ticks for each year from 2012 to 2023.
The data series is a single red line connecting data points for each year from 2012 to 2023.
The line shows a general upward trend from 2012 to 2022, with a peak in 2022, followed by a decline in 2023.

public_definitions: The goal is to assess the emergency department utilization dashboard and assign the record to the follow-up pathway that best fits the overall utilization pattern over the review period.
The comparison scope is the dashboard chart for Region Z from 2012 to 2023.
The rules are to use the dashboard as the evidence source for selecting the appropriate emergency department utilization follow-up pathway.
